result.question: Discuss how the 73rd Constitutional Amendment strengthened rural local self-government in India. What challenges remain?

directives.meaning: Look at the issue from more than one side, with reasons, and reach a balanced view.

sentences.text: The 73rd Amendment of 1992 gave constitutional status to panchayats and created a three-tier system of village, block and district panchayats.
It made elections every five years compulsory, and these elections are conducted by the Election Commission of India.
One-third of the seats are reserved for women, which has brought many women into local politics.
Panchayats now control all the subjects in the State List.
However, many panchayats still depend on grants from the State government and lack trained staff.
